key.name: monitor-groups
key.description: JSON map of connector name to group letter (A, B, C, …) used for custom multi-monitor layouts.

key.name: presentation-mode
key.description: Whether presentation mode (idle inhibit + Do Not Disturb) was last enabled. Restored after a Shell restart.

key.name: cast-auto-presentation
key.description: When true, starting a cast session enables presentation mode. Stopping cast restores the previous presentation state if the user had not enabled presentation manually.

key.name: last-cast-device
key.description: Identifier of the last Chromecast device used for mirroring.

key.name: cast-source
key.description: Which screen to capture when mirroring: "primary" or "all".

key.name: cast-display-enabled
key.description: Whether the Cast Display Quick Settings tile is turned on (discovery ready). Turning off stops any active cast session.

key.name: cast-device-groups
key.description: JSON map of cast device id to group letter (A, B, C, …) used when managing multiple connected devices.
